propositions: An unchanged related-material pin signed with a supported historical fingerprint generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) is incorrectly rejected as stale-pin-drift when the latest fingerprint differs due to algorithm evolution, despite recomputing current material under that historical generation matching the signed pin exactly

The pin-health derive_health function compares signed pins only against the latest fingerprint without applying the historical-generation compatibility logic already used for own-ticket attestation validation via _legacy_material_ok

A narrowly scoped compatibility predicate must be supplied from the attestation layer to classify a pin as current when recomputing current related material under any supported historical full-fingerprint generation matches the signed pin byte-for-byte
Genuine related-material drift (semantic edits to the dependent ticket) must continue to invalidate pins unconditionally, and arbitrary unmatched hashes must remain stale-pin-drift
